title: Kabseh
author: farag4m

step.title: Pressure cook chicken
step.text: Add chicken thighs to the pressure cooker with just enough water to reach the chicken surface. Add allspice, salt, black pepper, kabsa spices, and a little paprika. Pressure cook for 15 minutes.

ingredients.text: Water, just enough to reach the chicken surface

step.title: Remove broth
step.text: Take all the water out of the pot, leaving the chicken in the pot.

ingredients.text: Allspice, salt, black pepper, kabsa spices, little paprika

step.title: Brown chicken
step.text: Switch to saute mode and cook until the edges of the chicken get some color.

step.title: Saute aromatics
step.text: Add onions, add spices again, add tomato paste, and saute everything together with the chicken.

step.title: Add rice
step.text: Add 3 cups water and 3 cups rice to the pot using a 1:1 ratio.

step.title: Final cook
step.text: Pressure cook for 5 minutes, then natural release for 10 minutes.

notes: Original feedback: chicken tasted awful; rice did not have any taste. Consider increasing salt and kabsa spice in both the broth and rice stage, blooming the spices with the onions and tomato paste, and browning the chicken more deeply before adding rice.
